title: Vintage Glass Jar with Wooden Lid, 23.7 fl oz - Airtight Decorative Food Storage Canisters for Kitchen Counter, Ideal for Candy, Sugar, Coffee, Cookies
description:
About this item
Premium Material and Safety:The CUSTDE glass jar with lid is crafted from food-grade, premium thickened glass that is lead-free and BPA-free. It offers excellent stability and resistance to both low and high temperatures, making it safe and durable for storing a wide variety of foods.
Airtight Wooden Lid for Freshness:The Wooden lid with a silicone sealing ring creates a secure, airtight seal for the container, ensuring a moisture-resistant, dustproof environment that keeps food dry and fresh for longer.
Elegant Vintage Design:The vintage glass jar features an exquisite sunflower-embossed design, blending decorative elegance with practical functionality. Its versatile style enhances dining rooms, bars, offices, and pantries, making it both an organizational tool and a charming addition to any home decor.
Compact and Practical Dimensions:The glass jar measures 5.51 x 3.85 inches (14 x 9.8 cm) with a capacity of 23.7 fl oz (700 ml) for liquids or 0.54 lbs (230 g) of coffee beans. The bottle opening diameter is 2.95 inches (7.5 cm), and the weight (with lid) is 460 g. This compact glass jar is ideal for storing small items like coffee beans, spices, or snacks.
Practical Storage Solutions: These versatile glass jars, available in various sizes and patterns, are perfect for organizing your pantry or kitchen counter. Whether used to store everyday essentials like tea, coffee, sugar, and spices or as a stylish holder for candies, cookies, or nuts, these jars combine functionality with elegance. Their compact size and airtight bamboo lids make them equally suitable for gifting or enhancing festive settings.
